approval: 用户明确要求增加前五个开发工具；Rhino 为 KubeJS 必需且此前已批准

metadata.META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml:
modLoader = "javafml"
loaderVersion = "[3,)"
issueTrackerURL = "https://discord.gg/enginehub"
license = "GPLv3"

[[mods]]
modId = "worldedit"
version = "7.3.8+6939-7d32b45"
displayName = "WorldEdit"
displayURL = "https://enginehub.org/worldedit/"
description = '''
WorldEdit is an easy-to-use in-game world editor for Minecraft, supporting both single- and multi-player.
'''
authors = "EngineHub"
logoFile = "worldedit-icon.png"
displayTest = "IGNORE_SERVER_VERSION"

[[mixins]]
config = "worldedit-neoforge.mixins.json"

[[accessTransformers]]
file = "META-INF/accesstransformer.cfg"

[[dependencies.worldedit]]
modId = "minecraft"
type = "required"
versionRange = "[1.21,1.22)"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "BOTH"

[[dependencies.worldedit]]
modId = "neoforge"
type = "required"
versionRange = "[21.0.16-beta,)"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "BOTH"

modLoader = "javafml"
loaderVersion = "[2,)"
issueTrackerURL = "https://github.com/Prunoideae/ProbeJS"
license = "GPLv3"

[[mods]]
modId = "probejs"
version = "8.0.3"
displayName = "ProbeJS"
authors = "Prunoideae"
description = '''
Improving your KubeJS scripting experience by generating auto-completions of all kinds.
'''
logoFile = "icon.png"

[[dependencies.probejs]]
modId = "neoforge"
mandatory = true
versionRange = "[21.1.199,)"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "BOTH"

[[dependencies.probejs]]
modId = "minecraft"
mandatory = true
versionRange = "[1.21,)"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "BOTH"

[[dependencies.probejs]]
modId = "kubejs"
mandatory = true
versionRange = "[2101.7.2-build.365,)"

[[mixins]]
config = "probejs.mixins.json"

modLoader = "javafml"
loaderVersion = "[2,)"
issueTrackerURL = "https://kubejs.com/support?source=kubejs&mc=2101&loader=neoforge"
license = "GNU LGPLv3"

[[mods]]
modId = "kubejs"
version = "2101.7.2-build.377"
displayName = "KubeJS"
authors = "latvian.dev"
description = '''
Customize your modpack or server with JavaScript!
'''
logoFile = "kubejs_logo.png"
modUrl = "https://kubejs.com"
displayURL = "https://kubejs.com"

[[dependencies.kubejs]]
modId = "neoforge"
type = "required"
versionRange = "[21.1.199,)"
ordering = "AFTER"
side = "BOTH"

[[dependencies.kubejs]]
modId = "rhino"
type = "required"
versionRange = "[2101.2.7-build.81,)"
ordering = "AFTER"
side = "BOTH"

[[dependencies.kubejs]]
modId = "jei"
type = "optional"
versionRange = "[19.25.0.322,)"
ordering = "AFTER"
side = "CLIENT"

[[dependencies.kubejs]]
modId = "roughlyenoughitems"
type = "optional"
versionRange = "[16.0.799,)"
ordering = "AFTER"
side = "CLIENT"

[[dependencies.kubejs]]
modId = "emi"
type = "optional"
versionRange = "[1.1.22,)"
ordering = "AFTER"
side = "CLIENT"

[[dependencies.kubejs]]
modId = "betteradvancedtooltips"
type = "optional"
versionRange = "[2101.1.0-build.1,)"
ordering = "BEFORE"
side = "CLIENT"

[[mixins]]
config = "kubejs.mixins.json"

modLoader="javafml"
loaderVersion="[2,)"
authors="Luck"
license="GPLv3"

[[mods]]
modId="spark"
displayName="spark"
version="1.10.124"
description="spark is a performance profiling plugin/mod for Minecraft clients, servers and proxies."

[[accessTransformers]]
file="META-INF/accesstransformer.cfg"

[[dependencies.spark]]
modId = "neoforge"
mandatory=true
versionRange = "[20,)"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "BOTH"

modLoader = "javafml"
loaderVersion = "[1,)"
license = "CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0"

[[mods]]
modId = "jade"
version = "${file.jarVersion}"
displayName = "Jade"
authors = "Snownee"
displayURL = "https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jade"
description = "Minecraft mod shows what you are looking at. (Hwyla fork)"
logoFile = "icon.png"
credits = "TehNut, ProfMobius, kalkafox"

[[mixins]]
config = "jade.mixins.json"

[[dependencies.jade]]
modId = "neoforge"
type = "required"
versionRange = "[21.0.143, )"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "BOTH"

modLoader = "lowcodefml"
loaderVersion = "[2,)"
issueTrackerURL = "https://kubejs.com/support?source=rhino&mc=2101&loader=neoforge"
license = "MPL-2.0"

[[mods]]
modId = "rhino"
version = "2101.2.8-build.91"
displayName = "Rhino"
authors = "latvian.dev, Mozilla"
description = '''
